g.text: Title: 01 - ADS1299 core and SPI interface

g.desc: Title: 01 - ADS1299 core and SPI interface

g.text: BENCH DEVELOPMENT ONLY - NOT FOR BODY CONNECTION OR FABRICATION

g.desc: BENCH DEVELOPMENT ONLY - NOT FOR BODY CONNECTION OR FABRICATION

g.text: 3.3 V logic only. Pi GPIO uses the same voltage.

g.desc: 3.3 V logic only. Pi GPIO uses the same voltage.

g.text: Default pulldowns keep host inputs low at startup. MCU must release PWDN/RESET and drive CS high after rails settle.

g.desc: Default pulldowns keep host inputs low at startup. MCU must release PWDN/RESET and drive CS high after rails settle.

g.text: External controller power/USB can join GND. No body-connected tests.

g.desc: External controller power/USB can join GND. No body-connected tests.

g.text: J11: board-neutral connector; not an ESP32 dev-board footprint.

g.desc: J11: board-neutral connector; not an ESP32 dev-board footprint.

g.text: CONFIG1=0x96 (250 SPS, internal clock output disabled); MISC1=0x20 (SRB1); BIASREF_INT enabled in normal mode.

g.desc: CONFIG1=0x96 (250 SPS, internal clock output disabled); MISC1=0x20 (SRB1); BIASREF_INT enabled in normal mode.

g.text: 8 synchronous channels, 10 contacts. One ADS1299 contains both PGAs and ADCs.

g.desc: 8 synchronous channels, 10 contacts. One ADS1299 contains both PGAs and ADCs.

g.text: Global labels connect sheets. Negative inputs tie to AVDD; enable SRB1 in MISC1 before normal acquisition.

g.desc: Global labels connect sheets. Negative inputs tie to AVDD; enable SRB1 in MISC1 before normal acquisition.
